provider: FOSSVPS / ST-Hosting — free VPS for open-source developers (Frankfurt, Buffalo, LA, Chisinau)

free_tier.stated: Free VPSs on donated hardware; the Frankfurt node is an AMD EPYC 7402P, 128 GiB RAM, 1 TB SSD donated by ST-Hosting for at least two years. Per-VM disk is small (the node is large, the slices are not).

egress.terms: Node-level 1 Gbps; per-VM transfer not published. Unverified.

reliability_note: Donated capacity with published sunset dates and a public status page. Structurally temporary even when the VM is free.
